title: H125 / AS350 B3 (2B1) Quick Reference
intro: For training use only. This is an informal quick reference of selected H125 / AS350 B3 (2B1) RFM limitations and operating numbers. Always use the official RFM / QRH as primary reference.

items.label: VNE power on / power off (Hp = 0)
lines: VNE power on: 155 kt IAS at Hp = 0.
VNE power off: 125 kt IAS at Hp = 0.

items.label: Cold weather corrections
lines: OAT < -30 °C: reduce VNE power on by 10 kt.
OAT < -20 °C: reduce VNE power off by 20 kt (minimum 65 kt).

items.label: Arriel 2B1 (AEO)
lines: Use of the takeoff rating torque range has no time limit.

items.label: Engine takeoff rating
lines: Use of the engine takeoff rating range is limited to 5 continuous minutes.
Heating and demisting are forbidden above the engine maximum continuous rating (Ng or t4).

items.label: Ng (gas generator)
lines: Maximum continuous: ΔNg = -4 % (Ng 97.1 % at Hp = 0, ISA).
Takeoff rating range: ΔNg = -4 % to 0 %; maximum takeoff: ΔNg = 0 % (Ng 101.1 %).

items.label: Nf (power turbine)
lines: Minimum: 349 rpm; normal operating range: 349–418 rpm.

items.label: Flight
lines: Takeoff rating range: 849–915 °C; maximum takeoff rating: 915 °C.

items.label: Internal weight limits
lines: Maximum permissible internal weight in flight: 2250 kg (4961 lb).
Maximum permissible internal weight for IGE take-off and landing: 2250 kg (4961 lb).

items.label: Cabin floor
lines: Forward left cabin floor: max 150 kg.

items.label: Engine start
lines: Prohibited if snow or ice has collected in or around the engine air intake.

items.label: Engine oil
lines: Minimum oil temperature before power application: 0 °C (oil 5 cSt).
Minimum oil pressure (Ng ≥ 70 %): 1.1 bar (16 psi); caution ranges 1.1–2 bar and 6–9.8 bar.

items.label: Fuel anti-icing
lines: Fuel anti-icing additive mandatory if OAT < -20 °C and the fuel does not contain a freezing inhibitor.

items.label: Approved operations
lines: Approved for day and night VFR.
Flight in icing conditions is not permitted.

items.label: Crew & occupancy
lines: Minimum crew: 1 pilot in the right seat.

items.label: Prohibited operations (selected)
lines: Intentional engine power reduction in flight using the twist grip: prohibited (except where explicitly allowed for training/emergency procedures in the RFM).
